newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tongkah buys stake in laundry company.
newsitem.headline: Tongkah buys stake in laundry company.

text.p: Tongkah Applications Sdn Bhd, a subsidiary of Tongkah Holdings Bhd, is buying a 50 percent stake in Zoom Laundry & Dry Cleaners Sdn Bhd for 4.50 million ringgit, said Tongkah in a statement on Wednesday.
Tongkah said it had entered into an agreement with the existing shareholders of Zoom -- Tan & Tan Development Bhd, Mechmar Corporation (M) Bhd and Mensa Management Ltd -- to aqcuire the stake.
The purchase would be entirely funded with borrowings, Tongkah said.
The group said the purchase also fitted in well with subsidiary Tongkah Medivest Sdn Bhd's business of servicing government hospitals, which included the provision of laundry services.
Tongkah said the acquisition would not affect group earnings for the year ending June 30, 1997, but would benefit the group in the future.
